purpose: Behavior contract for general text-to-image Prompt creation, import, versioning, composition, reference binding and repair.

cases.prompt: 创建一个用于白色耳机产品图的通用 Prompt，不要加入电影镜头语言。
assertions: observation-ready product viewpoint, composition, light, or material decisions

cases.prompt: 导入我现有的一段人物 Prompt，保留原文并拆成 subject、lighting、style 和 negative blocks。
assertions: normalization does not claim a generation result

cases.prompt: 只把旧 Prompt 的背景从室内改成花园，生成新版本并保留父版本。
assertions: change log names one changed variable

cases.prompt: 把人物、背景和色温做成变量，生成三个一次只改变一个变量的变体。
assertions: each variant has an explicit single change

cases.prompt: 把一张人物参考图作为 identity，一张光线参考图作为 lighting，写清楚保留和排除内容。
评分这张人物参考图是否适合做身份、构图、灯光和真实感参考，并说明应该搭配什么参考图。
assertions: scores are for the declared purpose
authority is scored separately for identity, appearance, performance, capture, style and environment

cases.prompt: 把这张东方古典幻想人物参考图拆成面容、妆容、发型配饰、服装材质、姿态情绪、镜头、光线、色调和环境，再整理成可复用中文 Prompt。
assertions: visible evidence is separated from inference
camera details are marked as hypotheses when not supplied
identity and appearance ownership is explicit

cases.prompt: 把这个人物的脸型、五官、皮肤特征和辨识点固定下来，以后换衣服、换动作和换场景仍保持同一个人。
cases.expectedOutput: handoff to cineweave-character CharacterSpec or CharacterBinding, not a Director-only identity rewrite
assertions: reusable identity is routed to cineweave-character
appearance variables are separated from immutable identity
rights and likeness status are explicit
Director retains only shot-level observation decisions

cases.prompt: 人物身份用第一张图，妆造用第二张图，光线和胶片质感用第三张图；生成一个新角色，不能把三张图的脸混在一起。
cases.expectedOutput: prompt-record or reference-set with one role and scope per input
assertions: provider-specific reference strengths are not in the core Prompt
new identity is not silently copied

cases.prompt: 使用一个已经验证的宋韵 StylePackage 管理人物生图 Prompt，同时保留人物身份、服装状态和镜头块的独立性；以后还要切换成黑白漫画。
cases.expectedOutput: prompt-record with exact StyleCompile handoff and identity-preserving style switch
assertions: style package is versioned and scoped
exact styleBinding retains package and compile refs
image and video/temporal differences are explicit
prompt variants change one declared style variable

cases.prompt: 上一版总是把产品变成漂浮的广告海报，请诊断并只修复空间接触关系。
管理一个食物摄影 Prompt，只关注摆盘、蒸汽、表面质感和俯拍构图。
assertions: cinematic shot package is not required
observation-ready viewpoint, crop, light, and surface decisions
